culprit_citations.quoted_text: U.S. Treasury Bills | Cost 139,551 | Fair Value 139,551

findings.detail: The 139,551 U.S. Treasury Bills cash-equivalent fair value is included in the observed aggregate, producing 603,748 instead of the investments-only fair-value anchor of 464,197.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the filing's investments-only fair-value total is 464,197 (table 17 row 4), while total assets at fair value are 603,748 (table 17 row 6). The difference is the cash-equivalent line of 139,551 (table 17 row 5), also shown in the schedule as U.S. Treasury Bills under Cash and Cash Equivalents and Restricted Cash (table 10 rows 6-7). The flagged ratio 1.3006 corresponds to 603,748 / 464,197, so the holdings aggregate improperly includes cash equivalents against an investments-only denominator.
